operator_interruptions.cause: The private operator helper expected only a deleted flag, while the actual API also returns schema_version. It stopped after the source DELETE and did not retain that response.

operator_interruptions.cause: After exact metadata cleanup, the final read-only filesystem probe used the wrong worker Python working directory.
operator_interruptions.correction: The read-only probe was repeated in the configured application directory. No account or job mutation was repeated.
